versions.changelog:
Initial release of clinic-activity-report — a local, read-only skill to generate weekly clinic activity reports for veterinary clinic owners using NxVET data.

- Generates a plain-English weekly summary: total recordings, per-device/day/hour breakdown, trend vs last week, and health flags.
- Highlights silent devices, outdated firmware, and failing webhooks with clear, actionable flags.
- Outputs a markdown report; optionally a simple HTML dashboard.
- Never sends, edits, or deletes anything; strictly local and read-only.
- Requires NxVET API key and at least one active recording device.
- Efficient API usage via caching and ETag support to minimize server load and cost.
